narrative.headline: 2020 Dodge Charger: air bag complaints dominate owner reports
narrative.summary: Across 55 owner complaints to NHTSA, air bags are by far the most-reported area at 35 reports (64%) and account for the only fire (1), the only death (1), all 9 crashes, and 5 of the 6 injuries in this data. Everything else is much smaller: the electrical system and engine are tied at 6 reports each (11%), followed by the fuel/propulsion system at 3 (5%) and exterior lighting at 2 (4%). Outside of air bags, only exterior lighting has any reported injury (1), and no other category reports a crash, fire, or death.

A common thread is brakes engaging on their own. Service Brakes alone is tied to 11 crashes and 15 injuries; no fires were reported in any category. Electrical System (13%), Engine (8%), and Vehicle Speed Control (6%) round out the list.

The next four areas are all fuel- and engine-related: the fuel/propulsion system drew 23 reports (17%) with 1 fire and 1 injury, while the fuel system, gasoline, and engine each drew 15 reports (11%) with 1 fire apiece. If you are looking at one of these cars, air bag deployment is the issue to take most seriously.
